# Mago Labs

> Mago Labs is a founder-led website design and development studio in Surat, Gujarat, India. It builds custom, hand-coded websites for clinics, chartered accountancy firms, manufacturers and other small businesses, designed to turn visitors into enquiries. Clients work directly with the founder, Burhan Kapasi.

Key facts:

- Main service: custom website design and development, live in 5 to 28 days depending on the package. SEO, Google Business Profile and copywriting are offered alongside a website.
- Four website packages with fixed quotes. Starting prices in India: Launch ₹17,999 (5 days), Growth ₹29,999 (14 days), Scale ₹49,999 (21 days), Commerce ₹64,999 (28 days). Outside India (USD): Launch $799, Growth $1,149, Scale $1,899, Commerce $2,499. Visitors in Australia, New Zealand, the UK and euro countries see the same prices in AUD, NZD, GBP and EUR (for example Launch is A$1,149, NZ$1,449, £599 or €699).
- Results from client work: Dr. Mihir Shah Smile Care Clinic went from 25 to 58 patients a day within two months of launch. Darshan Galani & Co. signed 34 new clients within three months of launching its first website.
- Free website audit: send a website address and Mago Labs replies within one business day with what is stopping visitors from enquiring. Free, with no obligation.
- Contact: phone and WhatsApp +91 9099245605, email burhan@magolabs.in. Based in Surat, serving clients across India and abroad.

## Services

- [Services overview](https://www.magolabs.in/services): Everything Mago Labs offers and how the services fit together.
- [Website design and development](https://www.magolabs.in/services/web-design): Custom websites, hand-coded from a blank canvas, never a template.
- [SEO](https://www.magolabs.in/services/seo): Technical, on-page and local SEO.
- [Google Business Profile](https://www.magolabs.in/services/google-business-profile): Profile setup and optimisation for Google Maps visibility.
- [Copywriting](https://www.magolabs.in/services/copywriting): Clear, human-written website copy.
- [Pricing](https://www.magolabs.in/pricing): The four packages, what each includes, and timelines.

- [All case studies](https://www.magolabs.in/work): Websites built for clinics, CA firms, manufacturers and more, and what changed after launch.

- [Santosh Timbers](https://www.magolabs.in/work/santoshtimbers): Timber importer, from no website to a full product catalogue.
